limitations: Only15 adjacent development sessions of one contract; latest usable date2026-10-22. Not broad regime evidence or a current live-market assessment.
Recent5/preceding10 descriptive comparison was fixed before bucket analysis, but dates were already used for prior strategy development; not independent OOS.
Weekday composition is balanced; macro events, serial dependence and news effects are not controlled.
Minute close paths omit intraminute movement; RMS is uncentered, efficiency depends on sampling interval.
Five-minute sign changes do not imply profitable mean reversion after entry, stop, spread and slippage.
Volume is unsigned reported Last contracts. Upstream quotes exist, but spread, aggressor direction, queue and executable prices are not assessed here.
Cached ordering within equal source timestamps is inherited; exchange sequence not established.
No after-fee strategy return, stop/target, trading time filter, parameter threshold or adopted strategy follows from these metrics.

metrics_definition.context: Whole-session high-low range and open-close move reused from cafe-regime-inventory and checked against cache;bucket netpoints endpoint context only
metrics_definition.directional_efficiency: abs(last close-first open)/sum(abs(close-previous));same within-bucket path,undefined if path0
metrics_definition.five_minute_reversal_fraction: Sign changes between adjacent nonoverlapping5minute close movements using firstopen then preceding5minclose; exclude pairs with zero move; never span days/buckets
metrics_definition.rms_log_move_bps: 10000*sqrt(mean(log(close/previous)^2));first previous is bucket first open,then previous minute close;drift included,not centeredSD
metrics_definition.volume_per_minute: Sum reported Last trade volume / bucket minute count; unsigned recorded contract volume,not aggressor pressure

quantiles: Type7 linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; equal weight per session; IQR is observed dispersion, not confidence interval.
stop: Stop after one validated report and dashboard ACK,or on input/quality failure. No automatic new hypothesis or repetition.
